name: April Summers
source:
April, one of the high achievers, she used to hang out with the cool crowd, but something went down and now she is spending more and more time with Marty and the misfits.... She's kind and considerate and probably a lot smarter than she lets on!

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jagogames/the-lost-delinquents-of-rollings-high-visual-novel?ref=profile_saved_projects_live]Kickstarter[/url]]
